dict.string: SUBQUERY (extensionItems, $e, SUBQUERY ($e.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf").@count <= 1 AND SUBQUERY ($e.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "org.openxmlformats.wordprocessingml.document").@count <= 1 AND SUBQUERY ($e.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image").@count <= 20 AND SUBQUERY ($e.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" AND NOT (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.file-url")).@count <= 1 AND SUBQUERY ($e.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "org.openxmlformats.wordprocessingml.document" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url").@count == $e.attachments.@count AND $e.attachments.@count >= 1).@count == 1
